description: Export a preset with Godot 4.7 headless and check the result instead of trusting it. mode `pack` (default; needs no templates), `release` or `debug` (need export templates), `patch` (only what changed: Godot's --export-patch against `against` base packs or the preset's patches, or cut from a full export by `manifest`, the base game's file list with md5, default godotwright.json baseFiles; it never ships an unchanged base file nor misses a changed one, and lists every file), or `smoke` (run an existing `pck`). Stops early on an unknown preset, a BOM in export_presets.cfg or missing templates; checks the file is there; compares the pack with what the game loads (missing files with their load chain, editor-only and test files shipped); runs the exported game headless for `frames` (default 120, 0 = none) and reports runtime errors with call chains. Writes to .godot/godotwright/export/<preset>/ unless `out` is given. An error result on any error.

against.description: patch: base .pck files in load order

frames.description: frames to run the exported game (default 120, 0 = no run)

manifest.description: patch: lists of the base game's files (JSON with md5, or paths)

out.description: output file inside the project (.pck for pack and patch)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

pck.description: smoke: the .pck or exported game to run

preset.description: the preset (name or number); not needed for smoke

name: godot_export_run
title: Export headless, check the build and run it
